:::{#def-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error

For a random outcome $Y$ and a [prediction function](#def-prediction) $g(X)$,
the **prediction error** of $g$ is the prediction minus the outcome:

$$\prederr_g \eqdef g(X) - Y$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
the constant prediction $g_1(X) = 3$ has prediction error $\prederr_{g_1} = 3 - Y$,
which is $3$ when $Y = 0$ and $-3$ when $Y = 6$.

:::
